Cercospora shows widespread reddish-purple/bronze spots across the leaf - very different from the single clean lesion in the test image. Let me check two more.
Soybean rust shows many small tan/brown pustule spots scattered across the leaf. Not matching. One more view - let me revisit Frogeye with another reference to confirm.

This second Frogeye reference confirms the pattern: small spots with gray/light centers and dark margins scattered across leaves. The test image shows what appears to be an early-stage Frogeye leaf spot infection with a single characteristic lesion showing the hallmark **gray center with dark reddish-brown border**.

- The lesion has a distinctive **gray/light center** surrounded by a **dark reddish-brown margin**
- This is the textbook description of Frogeye leaf spot: "gray with reddish-brown borders"
- No other candidate matched: Phyllosticta has larger irregular tan patches, Septoria has dark brown spots on yellowing leaves, Bacterial blight has angular water-soaked spots, Cercospora has widespread purple/bronze discoloration, Soybean rust has many tiny tan pustules, SVN follows veins
